en.headline: MTR to extend services about 1.5 hours over Mid-Autumn Festival
en.dek: Local lines and Light Rail will run later on 25 September, with denser frequencies from mid-afternoon, while East Rail Line strengthens weekend services and high-speed rail adds trains.
body: The MTR Corporation will strengthen services across multiple lines for the Mid-Autumn Festival and the following weekend, extending local rail and Light Rail operations by about 1.5 hours on 25 September.

On the festival day itself, eight local lines will progressively increase frequency from 3pm to about every two minutes during the early evening peak. The East Rail, Island and Tuen Ma lines will also run denser services at selected evening periods. Last trains on local lines and Light Rail will depart between roughly 1am and 2am the next morning. MTR bus routes 506, K51 and K54A will likewise operate later.

Over the weekend of 26 and 27 September the East Rail Line will boost selected morning and afternoon services to and from Lok Ma Chau and Admiralty. Separately, the high-speed rail Hong Kong section will add long-haul sleeper trains to Beijing West and short-haul services to Futian and Shenzhen North from 23 to 27 September.

zh.headline: 港鐵中秋延長服務約1.5小時 多綫加密班次
zh.dek: 中秋節當日本地綫及輕鐵延長至凌晨一至二時許收車，下午三時起逐步加密至約兩分鐘一班，東鐵綫周末亦加強服務。
body: 港鐵公司宣布，中秋節及隨後周末將加強多條鐵路線服務。中秋節當日（9月25日），本地鐵路線及輕鐵將延長服務時間約1.5小時，尾班車於翌日凌晨1時多至2時多開出。
當日八條本地鐵路線由下午3時起逐步加密至約兩分鐘一班，東鐵綫、港島綫及屯馬綫於晚上部分時段亦會加密。港鐵巴士506、K51及K54A綫同樣延長服務。
隨後周六及周日，東鐵綫於上午及下午部分時段加強往落馬洲及金鐘方向班次。高鐵香港段則由9月23日起一連五日加強往北京西站長途臥鋪及往福田、深圳北短途班次。
